games.headline: Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup beats Oops
article: Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup beat Oops 86.60 to 73.00 in Week 8, a solid win decided by 13.60 points.

Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup managed 86.60 this week, 17.0 under their projected 103.6. Chuba Hubbard carried them with 21.4 points, about a quarter of the team's total, 7.2 over his projection. Dak Prescott (21.0) and Rashee Rice (14.8) were the other big contributors. It wasn't pretty: 86.60 was the 3rd-lowest score of the week. But a win is a win.
Oops managed 73.00 this week, 33.0 under their projected 106.0 and the 2nd-lowest score of the week. Drake Maye led the way with 27.5, and Rome Odunze added 10.7.
The letdown for Oops was DK Metcalf, who managed 0.9 on a 10.3 projection.
The letdown for Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup was Jonathan Taylor, who managed 4.7 on a 14.4 projection.
Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup could have scored even more by starting Tyler Allgeier (37.6) instead of Jeremiyah Love (2.3) and Ladd McConkey (10.6) instead of KC Concepcion (5.2).
At quarterback, Drake Maye (27.5) outdueled Dak Prescott (21.0).
Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup improves to 2-6 (11th place). Oops drops to 4-4 (6th).
Next week, Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup faces * Go Buckeyes (1-7), who are coming off a 46.6-point loss to The Canberra Mob and have lost 5 straight.
Next week, Oops faces K9 Unit (7-1), who are coming off a 23.9-point win over Dena's Team 🏈 and have won 6 straight. Oops will be without DK Metcalf (bye), so it's time to check the waiver wire.
